user.title: Vodafone Station (Technicolor)
user.description: Login of the router's web interface. Log out of the web interface in your browser first: the router allows only one session at a time.

reauth_confirm.title: Router login refused
reauth_confirm.description: The router refused the login, so updates have stopped to avoid locking its web interface. Enter the web interface password again (wait a few minutes first if the router has locked logins).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the router's web interface.
error.router_busy: Someone is logged in to the router's web interface. Log out there and try again.

abort.reauth_successful: The password was updated and updates have resumed.
